paragraphs.text: Local-first sticky notes for DeepSeek Harness Desktop: focus-mode WYSIWYG, images, audio, files and
inline YouTube/X/Vimeo/Spotify/TikTok/Instagram embeds. No AI, no transcription.
# Sticky Notes for DeepSeek Harness Desktop
Local-first sticky notes inside **DeepSeek Harness Desktop**: a sidebar panel, a full board, a focus

-mode
editor that is the note itself, rich HTML, images, audio, files and inline social embeds. **No

AI, no
transcription, no model downloads, no cloud account.**
**Español** → README.es.md
*The board is a real DSH panel: cards are previews, the sidebar entry belongs to the shell and every

note
lives under your DSH home.*
*Clicking a card opens read mode by default. The YouTube player is embedded through a local HTTP wra

pper,
so the player receives a valid referrer and plays inside the note. Cards with media open wide

enough to
watch it — no scrollbar inside the video.*
*Creating a note or pressing the pencil opens that same card in edit mode: toolbar, inline images, t

ables,
code blocks, category and tags, all inside the note. There is no separate form or modal with
ode blocks, category and tags, all inside the note. There is no separate form or modal with fields.*
*Attachments live in a rail at the bottom of the card: image thumbnails, an audio player and file ch

ips.
Content-heavy notes open proportionally taller so everything fits without nested scrolling.*
## Why Sticky Notes
- **One place for the small things** you need while editing or reviewing a session: reminders, clien

t
feedback, snippets, links, screenshots, voice notes.
- **Inline editing without a form.** The grid

card is a preview; clicking it expands the card into focus
mode. The title, body, toolbar, attachme

nts and metadata all stay inside the note.
- **Rich content that survives.** HTML is the canonical f

ormat, so tables, task lists, code blocks, links
and images are not flattened by a Markdown round-tr

ip.
- **Local by default.** Notes and attachments are files under your DSH home; no account, no tele

metry, no
sync, no AI.
## Features
| Area | What you get |
| Board | Sidebar entry, full central panel, pinned section, stats, search, category/tag/color filte

rs |
| Notes | Inline title and body, 8 pastel colors, pin/unpin, delete with undo |
| Drag | Live “
Moving …” banner, subtle target outline, a highlighted drop side and an orientation-aware insertion

bar: top/bottom for vertical moves, left/right for horizontal moves |
| Editor | TipTap WYSIWYG: bol
d, italic, strike, inline code, links, headings, lists, task lists, quotes, tables, images and code

blocks with a language picker and syntax colors (highlight.js, PowerShell included) |
| Focus mode |
Click a card to read it; press the pencil to edit. The card opens sized to its content — compact fo
r text, wide for video, tall for image/table/code notes — with a toolbar, attachments and metadata;

`Esc`, **Done** or backdrop close it |
| Card height | Cards grow up to ~640 px so most notes are re

adable without opening; only very long content needs focus mode |
| Attachments | Images, audio reco

rded with the microphone or uploaded, and generic files; served from local disk |
| Embeds | YouTube

, X, Vimeo, Spotify, TikTok, Instagram and generic link cards, inline in the note |
| Organization |
One category and up to 12 tags per note; search across title, text, tags, category and attachments

|
| Storage | `notes.json`, atomic writes, `.bak`, daily backups, attachment files |
| Agent | Optio

nal `sticky_notes` tool, disabled by default; Markdown in and out |
| UI | English interface, light
and dark themes, keyboard focus handling, reduced motion |
### No AI, no transcription
The plugin does **not** ship or call a speech-to-text model. Audio is recorded, stored and played ba

ck;
there is no transcript, no SenseVoice, no Whisper, no model download and no per-use AI cost. The

optional
`sticky_notes` agent tool only exposes notes to the DSH agent you already use; it does not

call a model by
itself and is disabled by default.
### Embeds are the only third-party surface
Notes and attachments are local. A YouTube/X/Vimeo/Spotify/TikTok/Instagram embed loads content from

that
provider when you open the note in focus mode; the board itself only shows static cards. This

means network
[该节后续省略]
## Requirements

- **DSH Desktop** `>= 0.2.1-rc.3`, profile `desktop`; tested on `0.2.2-rc.1`, Windows 11.
- Node `>=

22`.
- Microphone permission only if you record audio.
- Internet only for social embeds and for op
ening external links.
## Data and privacy
Default data directory:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Path | Contents |

| `notes.json` | Notes, HTML content, metadata, revisions and settings |
| `notes.json.bak` | Previo

us version before the last write |
| `backups/notes-YYYY-MM-DD.json` | Daily backups, rotated |
| `a
ttachments/<uuid>.<ext>` | Images, audio and files |

- Writes are atomic (temp file + rename) and permissions are restricted to your user.
- Attachment U

RLs include an unguessable token; they are served by the local DSH server.
- No account, cloud sync,

telemetry or AI service is used.
- The optional agent tool can put note content into the session lo

g when enabled. Leave `agentTools:
false` if you do not want that.
- To remove everything, close DSH
and delete the `stickynotes` folder.
## Architecture
- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`, `lib/host/*`): HTTP routes under `/api/dsh-stickynotes`, `NoteStore

`,
attachment storage, HTML sanitization, Markdown derivation, optional agent tool.
- **Client half*

* (`src/client/*`, built into `lib/client.js`): a `window.__ModuleLoader__` bundle that
registers `s

idebar.panellist` and `main`, renders React from the DSH module table, and mounts TipTap
only in foc

us mode.
- **Storage** is local JSON plus attachment files; see docs/architecture.md.
## Compatibility and limitations

- Windows 11 tested; macOS/Linux not verified.
- Embeds depend on the provider, network and the shel

l CSP. A blocked embed leaves the link card.
- The board shows static embed cards; full iframes/scri

pts load only in focus mode.
- No full trash view (delete has undo), no export/import yet, no priori

ty, no free canvas.
- No AI, transcription, speech-to-text, model download or cloud speech provider.
- The current version is a first release; back up `stickynotes` if you keep important notes.
